query: User has a lending account with XLM supplied and USDC borrowed. Add a button that repays the USDC debt using their XLM collateral, and also handle the case where they borrowed and supplied the same token.
expected_behavior: Uses `buildStellarRepayDebtWithCollateralTx` with the EXISTING `accountNonce` from userPositions (never 0 — repay requires an existing account), `collateral`/`debt` as `{ hubId, asset }` pairs, and `collateralAmount` as a base-unit string

Quotes `from: collateral asset -> to: debt asset` so that the quote's `amountIn` equals `collateralAmount` (forward: `amountIn` = collateral sold; reverse: `amountOut` = buffered ceiled debt, then `quote.amountIn` as `collateralAmount`; never the debt amount as `amountIn`), without `sender`, and maps it into `steps` via `mapQuoteResponseToStrategySwap`

For the same-token case passes EMPTY swap bytes (`buildSameTokenRepaySwapSteps()` / `new Uint8Array(0)`) and makes no quote request; does not send a placeholder or self-swap route (controller asserts `swap.is_empty()` and reverts with InvalidPayments otherwise)

Sets `closePosition` explicitly and explains that `true` requires the repayment to clear all debt (else `CannotCloseWithRemainingDebt`) and then withdraws every remaining supply position to the caller
Prepares and simulates the composed transaction before signing; the quote's own simulation does not cover the controller call
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.214 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@^16
The same-token branch passes a zero-length Uint8Array (or buildSameTokenRepaySwapSteps()) as `steps` and makes no quote request
